slots.notes: Footer brand wordmark/logo; rendered at h-6 and recolored to solid fg via CSS filter brightness(0), so a single-color (preferably SVG) transparent mark is expected.
FAQ accordion expand/collapse glyph pair (ChevronDown collapsed, ChevronUp expanded), size 20, currentColor-tinted. Currently sourced from lucide-react; swappable icon socket.

mechanic: Static two-column CTA-plus-FAQ grid over a white page, anchored by a left card whose looping multi-blob radial-gradient background drifts and pulses via animated CSS @property custom properties, beside a single-open click-toggle FAQ accordion and a four-column footer.
techDelivery: React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS, lucide-react icons, animated gradient authored as hand-written CSS @property + @keyframes appended after the Tailwind directives in src/index.css; Inter loaded via Google Fonts link in index.html.
reskinNotes: Gradient is six hardcoded hex stops (base #ff8e53 + blobs #fff1aa/#ff4b2b/#8aff8a/#ffd000/#ff1493) baked into the .c5-animated-gradient CSS rule, not driven by the color tokens, so re-skinning the CTA card means editing the raw CSS. Logo depends on a brightness(0) filter that only yields a clean mark if the asset is a solid single-color transparent SVG. All copy (headline, FAQ Q/A pairs, nav links, newsletter, footer legal) and the many surface/border greys (#eaeaea, #f0f0f0, #666, #888, #fafafa) are hardcoded inline in the markup rather than tokenized.
